imports.title: main deployment · fixed 20-task baseline
imports.change: Unified coordinator, Mac serve and Windows agent on main e017d84. Harness c5913cf was separate from the measured runtime.
imports.result: 20/20 official task checks passed. 808.884 s end-to-end; 98 model requests. This is not a 164-task leaderboard or GPU throughput benchmark.

imports.title: Same-runtime rerun · tool-call failure retained
imports.change: Reran the same fixed cohort after harness merge 1571071; harness hash and all three e017d84 runtime components unchanged. TUI was also open; environment not exclusive.
imports.result: 19/20 official checks passed; HumanEval/149 failed with a malformed tool call. 774.288 s includes early failure, not a speedup. Separate 9.068 s retry is excluded. Per-task token counts were not published.

runs.title: Post-merge main · measured worker P/D and client TTFT
runs.change: Fresh fixed 20-task baseline after merging results #47 then homepage code #46; rebuilt and verified coordinator/serve/agent at the same main commit. Two local observation hops capture raw worker timings and client output receipt without changing product inference code.
runs.result: 20/20 official task assertions passed. All 92 model requests have matched worker timing and client TTFT observations. Separate observation configuration; this is not a controlled speedup comparison or a 164-task leaderboard.
